explanation: This is the planar Nandakumar–Ramana Rao theorem, proved by Avvakumov, Akopyan and Karasev: every convex body in the plane can be cut into n convex pieces that are fair, meaning they have equal area and equal perimeter. The statement uses only the library's own definitions (`Geometry.ConvexBody`, `Geometry.Plane`, `ConvexPartition`, `IsFair`). The proof just applies the library's own lemma `avvakumov_akopyan_karasev`, not a Mathlib declaration. I did not run a search: going by my knowledge of Mathlib, it has no fair-partition theorem for convex bodies, and nothing equivalent to this deep result. So no Mathlib declaration carries its content.
